findings.summary: The shared Disconnect-or-block operation now requires owner reauthentication, but affordance.ConnectionPanel.block and journey step J.control.block/b2 still only require confirmation, so Block contradicts the operation's preconditions.
The step now includes reauthentication, but its branch only models confirm and cancel; there is no path for the newly specified reauthentication failure, which should deny the disconnect.

The added reauthentication claim is sourced only to S.webapp.concurrency, and neither that nor any other requirement mandates reauthentication for disconnect, so the criterion asserts an untraced requirement.
